summary:
calcx/parser.py — root cause was `parse_expr` always recursing with `prec + 1` for the right operand, making every operator left-associative; right-assoc ops (`^`, `**`) need to recurse with the same `prec` so a trailing same-precedence op binds to the right instead.
All 21 tests pass, including `test_right_associative_power`.
